title: Area-code shard C pass 24 — 659 / 662 / 680
summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public-person enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 659, 662, and 680.

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 659, 662, and 680?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public-person role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, residence, or public role.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Food Not Bombs Birmingham has current public meal/cook, activism and social surfaces and March 2026 public-activity corroboration. Birmingham DSA has current first-party mutual-aid/labor/tenant organizing and public social/community participation surfaces. Neither is upgraded to explicitly self-described anarchist; FNB Birmingham is retained as anarchist-associated through the Food Not Bombs family.

Tupelo Mutual Aid Project is corroborated by organization-controlled and current regional resource pages and directly publishes 662-301-7432; Janet A. Hardy is publicly listed as Treasurer. TupeloCore is a current Tupelo mutual-aid food-security network. No anarchist label is inferred.

560 Art Collective has a current public Linktree and a current intentional-community listing explicitly describing it as a long-standing anarchist artist collective. Syracuse Peace Council has current 2026 activity and a current public Steering Committee naming six members. NPA 680 overlays 315, so locality relations assert no 680 phone ownership.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass
